description: Sceptically rated GenAI learning resources catalogue (decision D-027): all 52 rated resources from T0-68 plus 8 primary technical specifications and engineering references from T0-13, T0-16 and T0-69, mapped across all 12 canonical role families.
basis: Primary census from T0-68 (retrieved 2026-11-13; anchored 2026-11-11; 52 rated resources, 88 family rows; mostly search extracts capped at Grade B). Maven AI Evals tuition reconciled with T0-21 (primary enrolment page read 2026-11-14: US$4,500 for 2027-01-30 to 2027-03-27, >=20% team discount). Eight additional primary technical specs and references added unscored from T0-13, T0-16 and T0-69. Rubric scores are Grade M (model calculations) and inherit the weakest input grade.

rubric.formula: T = 4A + 4C + 4H + 5R + 3$ (0-5 per criterion, total out of 100; outcome adjustment and gates G1-G5 applied afterwards)

bands.use_with_care: 55-74, or capped from use by G1 (currency), G2 (paid refund/outcome gate) or G5 (incomplete)
bands.watch: 40-54, unverified paid programme without opened terms, or capped by G4 (seller-awarded title)
bands.avoid: G4 adverse regulator/court finding, closure, or retired-API/seller-title fail

gates.G1: Currency: a fast-topic resource >18 months old is capped at use-with-care; material built on a retired API is avoid.
gates.G2: Paid gate: above US$100 / INR 8,000, use requires a confirmed full-refund window >=14 days from the first session and traceable (or no) outcome claims.
gates.G3: Conflict of interest (COI): vendor-authored, lab-authored or monetised material is explicitly flagged without score penalty.
gates.G4: Standing and regulatory gate: seller-awarded titles without independent assessment are capped at watch; regulator/court adverse findings or closure mean avoid.
gates.G5: Completeness gate: partial or unfinished courses with unpublished core units are capped at use-with-care.

applied-ai-engineering.label: Applied AI Engineering
applied-ai-engineering.minimal_free: DataTalks.Club LLM Zoomcamp (graded project, evaluation module); model-provider docs plus pinned SDK docs (AI SDK 7 or LangChain 1.x); Hugging Face Agents Course (agent loop, free certificate).
applied-ai-engineering.minimal_paid: None needed. Optional: Maven AI Evals (US$4,500 for the 2027-01-30 cohort; >=20% team discount for 2+) only if employer-funded after building harness v0.

ml-engineering-applied-science.label: ML Engineering & Applied Science
ml-engineering-applied-science.minimal_free: Karpathy Zero to Hero -> Hugging Face LLM Course -> ML or MLOps Zoomcamp (fundamentals to fine-tuning to serving) plus TRL v1.0 docs; Stanford CS336 optional.
ml-engineering-applied-science.minimal_paid: Raschka's Build a Reasoning Model (~US$60) if post-training is the target; otherwise none.

forward-deployment-solutions.label: Forward Deployment & Solutions
forward-deployment-solutions.minimal_free: DataTalks.Club LLM Zoomcamp; provider, MCP/A2A and cloud docs; Hugging Face Agents Course for customer-facing prototypes.
forward-deployment-solutions.minimal_paid: Chip Huyen's AI Engineering (~US$55-80) for architecture vocabulary; paid Indian programmes (e.g. Scaler FDE) only after verifying written refund terms.

ai-infrastructure-platform.label: AI Infrastructure & Platform
ai-infrastructure-platform.minimal_free: Stanford CS336 systems lectures; GPU MODE lectures; DataTalks.Club MLOps Zoomcamp; PyTorch FSDP2 and TensorRT-LLM PyTorch migration docs.
ai-infrastructure-platform.minimal_paid: Programming Massively Parallel Processors, 5th edition (~EUR 66-74) and rented GPUs at US$0.29-0.93/h for labs.

evaluation-safety-security.label: Evaluation, Safety & Security
evaluation-safety-security.minimal_free: Inspect AI docs; Hamel Husain's blog; OWASP GenAI LLM Top 10 2026 and Agentic Top 10; NSA AISC MCP Security guidance; BlueDot Technical AI Safety.
evaluation-safety-security.minimal_paid: Maven AI Evals (US$4,500) only if employer-funded.

research.label: Research
research.minimal_free: Stanford CS336; Karpathy Zero to Hero; Hugging Face Ultra-Scale Playbook and TRL v1.0; BlueDot Technical AI Safety or the public ARENA curriculum.
research.minimal_paid: Raschka's Build a Reasoning Model (~US$60, optional).

governance-risk-assurance.label: Governance, Risk & Assurance
governance-risk-assurance.minimal_free: NIST AI RMF 1.0 and AI 600-1; EU AI Act explorer with Digital Omnibus text (verify against EUR-Lex); OWASP 2026; BlueDot Frontier AI Governance.
governance-risk-assurance.minimal_paid: None verified in T0-68; proctored certifications are catalogued in data/credentials.json.

product-program.label: Product & Program
product-program.minimal_free: Hugging Face LLM Course; Hamel Husain's blog; BlueDot The Future of AI (2 h).
product-program.minimal_paid: Maven AI PM (US$2,500 list) or Maven AI Evals (US$4,500), employer-funded only.

human-data-eval-ops.label: Human Data & Evaluation Operations
human-data-eval-ops.minimal_free: aitrainer.work AI Trainer Academy; Hamel Husain's blog (rubrics, error analysis); Inspect AI docs.
human-data-eval-ops.minimal_paid: None recommended; seller-awarded evaluator titles lack independent employer standing.

embodied-physical-ai.label: Embodied & Physical AI
embodied-physical-ai.minimal_free: NVIDIA Physical AI courses (Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, GR00T); MIT Underactuated Robotics (Tedrake); Hugging Face Robotics Course (LeRobot); Karpathy Zero to Hero.
embodied-physical-ai.minimal_paid: Hardware or rented GPU only (24 GB+ GPU for Isaac Sim per a third-party guide, Grade C).

leadership-executive.label: Leadership & Executive
leadership-executive.minimal_free: BlueDot AGI Strategy; NIST AI RMF 1.0; EU AI Act explorer (Omnibus); DataTalks.Club LLM Zoomcamp (to see what engineering teams build).
leadership-executive.minimal_paid: Chip Huyen's AI Engineering (~US$55-80); executive programmes (e.g. Chicago Booth US$28,000) are price context only.

independent-fractional.label: Independent & Fractional
independent-fractional.minimal_free: NIST AI RMF 1.0; Hamel Husain's blog; model-provider API documentation.
independent-fractional.minimal_paid: Chip Huyen's AI Engineering (~US$55-80); Maven AI Evals (US$4,500). Avoid vendor-awarded CAIO or consultant titles.
